I answered Hollis in our DM: send the truck to Bay 25.

That comes from his own note to me on Oct 14, saved privately to him. He said that from then on, Bay 25 is his dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups on the Ashgrove project. Nothing in the channels or shared files he can see mentions a different bay. I told him to check with the site before locking in Thursday in case the bay has changed since then.
